jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer: Patrol, Access & Customer Service
jobs.description:
Allied Universal, North America’s leading security and facility services company, is hiring a Security Officer Unarmed Patrol in Dallas, TX. You will monitor access, perform unarmed patrols, assist tenants and visitors, and report security concerns, contributing to a safe, welcoming environment.

This full-time role pays $19.67 per hour. Minimum requirements include a high school diploma or equivalent and at least 1 year of security experience; background checks and a drug screen are required.

jobs.title: Full-Time Patrol Driver - Unarmed Security (DC)
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Fort Worth, TX is seeking a Security Officer Full Time Patrol Driver. You will serve clients at a logistics site, perform patrols, monitor access, and deliver excellent customer service.

This driving position requires a valid license, a strong safety mindset, and the ability to work a night schedule. Allied Universal offers training, growth, and comprehensive benefits.

jobs.title: Retail Security Officer — Unarmed Patrol & Customer Service
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer in Allen, TX to perform unarmed patrols, provide customer service, and deter incidents across a retail environment. The role emphasizes visible presence, situational awareness, and timely responses to security-related concerns.

The position is full-time with a daytime schedule, and training and career growth opportunities are offered. A background check and drug screening are required by policy, with a focus on safety and integrity.
